answer: A per-identity bond with proof-of-work is the Sybil brake. Each AI agent locks a bond on-chain and solves a fresh memory-hard challenge whose difficulty scales with how many identities share one funding source. A thousand wallets pay that bond per seat, unlocked after long vesting, so capital traps per fake account. The attacker pays bond times account count plus compute, far above any pool share, and shared-funding detection triggers slashing. The quartz anchor makes each seat provably paid, the nadir of per-seat payoff sits below the bond, and the prism of difficulty splits sybil clusters.
